name: s-maker
description: Make music with Strudel: MIDI import, LLM co-composer, sharing for a small group.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace apps/server" "npm run dev --workspace apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p apps/server --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit
